question: What does the Spirit do in baptism?

answers.label: Baptism itself gives the Holy Spirit
The water cleanses; the Spirit is given with the laying on of hands that follows
Baptism in the Spirit is a later experience after conversion

overview.text: In the West about 200, the water was said to cleanse and prepare, and the Spirit to be given by the bishop's laying on of hands at the same rite (Tertullian, Cyprian).
In the East the Spirit's gift is joined to the water itself, sealed at once with chrism (Cyril). Pentecostals speak of a distinct, later baptism in the Spirit.

quotes.author: Tertullian
quotes.english: Not that we receive the Holy Spirit in the waters, but cleansed in the water under the angel we are prepared for the Holy Spirit. Here too a figure went before: John was the Lord's forerunner, preparing his ways.
quotes.original: Non quod in aquis spiritum sanctum consequamur, sed in aqua emundati sub angelo spiritui sancto praeparamur. hic quoque figura praecessit; sic enim Iohannes antepraecursor domini fuit praeparans uias eius.
quotes.context: For Tertullian the water cleanses and the laying on of hands that follows gives the Spirit (chapter 8).

quotes.author: Tertullian
quotes.english: Then a hand is laid on us in blessing, calling and inviting the Holy Spirit.
quotes.original: Dehinc manus imponitur per benedictionem advocans et inuitans spiritum sanctum.
quotes.context: Same rite, same day: water, anointing, hands.

quotes.author: Cyprian of Carthage
quotes.english: Those baptized in the Church are brought to the leaders of the Church, and by our prayer and laying on of hands they receive the Holy Spirit and are made complete with the Lord's seal.
quotes.original: ut qui in ecclesia baptizantur praepositis ecclesiae offerantur et per nostram orationem ac manus inpositionem spiritum sanctum consequantur et signaculo dominico consummentur.
quotes.context: Cyprian also says that baptism outside the Church cannot give the Spirit (73.6).

quotes.author: Cyril of Jerusalem
quotes.english: We know well that just as it cleanses from sins and brings the gift of the Holy Spirit, so it is also the copy of Christ's sufferings.
quotes.original: ἀκριβῶς εἰδότων ἡμῶν, ὅτι ὡς ἔστιν ἁμαρτημάτων καθαρτήριον καὶ Πνεύματος ἁγίου δωρεᾶς πρόξενον, οὕτω καὶ τῶν τοῦ Χριστοῦ παθημάτων ἀντίτυπον.
quotes.context: In the East the gift of the Spirit is spoken of with the water and sealed at once with chrism.

quotes.author: Assemblies of God
quotes.english: This experience is distinct from and subsequent to the experience of the new birth.
quotes.original: This experience is distinct from and subsequent to the experience of the new birth.
quotes.context: Pentecostals teach a baptism in the Spirit distinct from and after new birth.

source.edition: Assemblies of God, Statement of Fundamental Truths
